name: The Best Plan
pitch: One sheet of paper puts the killing blow on a bill, you pick their pocket and leave before it falls due, and then you spend your life making sure everyone you owe dies first.
channel: none: wins by a Fled result

new.name: Promissory Paper
new.effect: A talisman, stock used up: Slow Wound at share 1.0 for this fight, from the instant it fires. Closes: every fight costs a rare sheet, and with none left an old bill lands whole.

new.name: Skipped Bill
new.effect: On a Fled result the ledger is not paid in years. It is written in the Creditors' Book against the one who dealt it.
new.second_home: any debtor, any NPC who owes the player

new.name: Dies Later
new.effect: When a creditor dies by any hand but yours, the entry is void, heart demon falls by 3, and you claim 1 % of their carried stones per 100 % owed, to 25 %.

new.name: Cold Feet
new.effect: Escape arts first fire at cooldown_min.
new.second_home: any trapper's getaway, any NPC guard who sounds an alarm

new.name: Beneath Notice
new.effect: Against a pursuer above you, the escape realm term is +0.05 a realm, not -0.10.

new.name: Terror
new.effect: +0.15 escape bonus while the ledger exceeds your health.

new.name: Full Sleeve
new.effect: +0.02 escape bonus per doubling of talismans carried above 4, read at the start of a fight.

new.name: Folded Corner
new.effect: The first failed roll of a fight puts its talisman back in stock.

new.name: Not-Yet-Used Sheet
new.effect: Escape art, e_art 0.70, stock 1, guarded on own health below 30 %.

new.name: Goat in Passing
new.effect: Cost 0.02, 0.5 s. Each firing lifts one carried thing, cheapest first, kept only on a Fled result.

new.name: Thirty-Six Exits
new.effect: Secret, Huyền giai, Water. Carries Cold Feet, Full Sleeve, Folded Corner, Skipped Bill, Dies Later and Goat in Passing, and seals Hidden Doors.

new.name: Hidden Doors
new.effect: Sealed, Water, size 6, four Escape chance acupoints, notables Terror and Beneath Notice. Theme: escape.

new.name: The Creditors' Book
new.effect: A per-life list of creditor and share. Against a creditor the share stands in the ledger at t = 0, and lands whole at the first pulse if no Slow Wound runs. An entry ends with the creditor's life.

questions: Flight is always the failure branch for the player today (AC-CB-62). Should an Event Engine fight over something you already hold count a flight as your success, so that leaving with the goods is a real ending?
No flight can happen before 1.5 s: cooldown_min 0.5 plus escape_channel 1.0. Anything that kills sooner cannot be fled from. Is that floor intended?

This sheet reads talismans as costing no linh lực, since crafting_talismans.json has no such field. A linh lực price would kill this build, because the ward empties the pool first. Is that reading right?
